title: Task 3: Public exports and SRD attribution surface
description: Objective: Make the SRD lookup API available from @loreweaver/core and verify license metadata is returned with lookup results. Files: modify packages/core/src/index.ts; modify packages/core/test/srd.test.ts; optionally modify README.md only if public API documentation is necessary. Steps: 1. Add failing tests importing lookupSrd, SRD_LICENSE, and SRD_CATALOG from ../src/index.js and asserting a successful lookup includes license attribution. Command: npm run test -- packages/core/test/srd.test.ts. Expected RED: exports missing from index.ts or result lacks metadata. 2. Export runtime API and types from packages/core/src/index.ts. 3. Run focused test to GREEN. 4. Run npm run build and npm run test. 5. Commit the task changes.
design: Keep index.ts as the only package barrel. Export type-only symbols with export type. Do not expose mutable internals; SRD_CATALOG should be readonly at the type level.
acceptance_criteria: Consumers can import the SRD catalog metadata and lookupSrd from @loreweaver/core; build and tests pass.
close_reason: Exported SRD catalog, license metadata, lookup facade, store helpers, and public types from @loreweaver/core; verification: npm run build passed and npm run test passed with 25 passed / 1 skipped; TDD evidence recorded.
